2. The scales of space

Partial

2.1 The natural hierarchy

LevelWhat it isSizeStatus
Galaxythe star’s place in it; the local star field (stars within 10 pc, each with a seed from which a system could be made) and the night sky (stars to magnitude 6, the Milky Way, asterisms)–partial: no other systems are generated
Star systemstar, planets, moons, belts–built
Planetthe main world–built
Continenta landmass of 1 % of the surface or more; large islands and islands below that–built
Subcontinentregions that touchabout 10 regionsbuilt
Regiona cell of the map with its ground, climate band, height, temperature, rain25 000 km² by default (lockable: regionKm2)built
Landscapefeatures alike in height and coastabout 3.5 featuresbuilt
Featurezones of one family of groundabout 6 zonesbuilt
Zoneone stretch of one kind of ground; the basic unit50–600 km²built
Subzonea place in a zone, and the void that fills the rest1–5 km², 3–20 per zonebuilt

The sea has regions and zones in two layers (surface and floor). Large lakes have a rim and a freshwater middle. Rivers and ridgelines are barrier zones. See Geography and Polity Module – Specification. Landmarks are listed in section 7.

2.2 The political overlay

LevelWhat it is
Realman independent power; its title now comes from the culture’s government (section 12)
Territorya part of a realm administered as one
Districtthe smallest unit of administration: zones that touch

A zone is held, contested, ungoverned or wilderness.

Still to build Galaxy generation (in part)

The project’s scope runs "from an entire galaxy down to minute details". The local star field gives each nearby star a seed for makeSystem, but no other system is generated, and there is no travel or contact between worlds (Solar System Module – Additions §2).
